programs.title: Europe's New Wild
programs.desc: There is no shortage of impressive metropolises and monuments of civilization on the European continent.Regions free from human interference are particularly valuable here.Past generations have witnessed the extinction of some animal species.The six-episode documentary series contains an optimistic message that nature can regenerate.The filmmakers showed the activities of scientists who are trying to rebuild fragile ecosystems in places such as the Carpathians, Lapland and the Danube Delta.In this episode they will also visit Poland.The return of the wolf, bison and lynx Viewers will learn about the effects of the program to restore the bison population in the Romanian mountains.This species plays an important role in shaping the landscape and influences the lives of other animals.The cameras captured an exciting confrontation between a herd of these majestic deer and wolves.To learn about the situation of dog ancestors, who often fell victim to humans, the documentarians went to Poland.One of the heroes of the episode is a persistent bassist.Released in the Kampinos National Park, the wolf traveled a long way alone - only in the mountains did it find a home.The filmmakers also showed the story of Slovak lynxes, which were used to rebuild the population of this species in Germany.

programs.title: Moody Beasts
programs.desc: Viewers will find answers to questions about animals.They will learn why male moose become covered in their own urine, clownfish change sex, and the brown moose dies after mating.

programs.title: Close Encounters of the Wild Kind: Season 1
One Strange Rock
programs.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken, among others, in the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.

programs.title: Europe From Above 4
programs.desc: The Old Continent seen from an extraordinary perspective.A bird's eye view will allow you to discover architectural treasures as well as natural gems.Europe will also be shown during different seasons.

programs.title: Killer Safari: Big Cat Battle Compilation Season
programs.desc: Tourists hope to be able to take photos of the big cats.Meanwhile, they witness an elephant charging.Leopards fight for territory.Cheetahs must face crocodiles, and a lone lion must face a herd of buffaloes.
